messages:
maya: CI red on linux-x86_64: //runtime:session_state_gc_test failing intermittently (3/10). Looks like session invalid state after GC. Anyone seen this recently?

jess: ah ok, can you paste the failing log snippet? or a test run id so I can pull artifacts? :eyes:

maya: artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/4827/artifacts/log.txt
maya: log snippet:
```
E SESSION: session id=abc123 invalid_state after gc
runtime/session.go:256: panic: nil pointer dereference
goroutine 42 [running]:
runtime/stack.go:...
```

rob: pinging CI to rerun once, will watch. If it repros consistently we can bisect.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by rob — build 4828 queued. (Triggered rerun of 4827)

avery: this smells like a timing race between session finalizer and eviction. Test does a forced GC + immediate read, maybe the finalizer path can mutate session state concurrently.

dave: can you reproduce locally with `bazel test //runtime:session_state_gc_test --runs_per_test=50` ? if yes, try `--test_arg=--seed=...` to capture deterministic run.

maya: started local runs, 1/40 fail so far. I have an env var in the repro: RANDOM_SEED=42

jess: while you bisect, can we short-term mark the test flaky in CI to stop noise? I can open a tiny PR to add `[flake:maybe]` tag to that target.

rob: noted PR would be fine as stopgap. pls add a comment pointing to this thread + artifact link.

maya: giving bisect a try now. quick question: does anyone remember PR that touched session finalizers recently? I think it was in the 1234 series.

avery: yep PR #1234 changed finalizer ordering to avoid double-free — might be related.

dave: suggestion: add a small yield between GC and read in the test to see if timing changes the repro rate. e.g. `time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)` — if that reduces failures it indicates race.

maya: tried sleep 10ms, failure rate dropped to 0/50. That strongly suggests a race.

jess: good find. can you try switching to explicit finalizer run instead of relying on GC to narrow root cause? `runtime.GC(); debug.FreeOSMemory()` or call the finalizer function manually in test harness.

maya: will try both. running `go test -run TestSessionGC -count=50` with debug.FreeOSMemory now.

ci-bot: Build 4828 completed: PASSED (rerun fixed transient).

rob: since rerun passed we need a plan: bisect PRs since last green, reproduce reliably locally, then fix by serializing finalizer mutation or using mutex.

jess: I'll open the flaky tag PR now and add a link to this thread + note that eng-runtime is triaging.

avery: If bisect points to PR #1234 we might need to revert or adjust finalizer to use atomic ops.

maya: starting git bisect (script will run bazel test). ping me if you want to pair.

dave: happy to pair for the bisect tomorrow morning. good call adding flaky tag short-term. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — will post updates here. (added test run id and local repro steps in the issue)

jess: thanks — keep us posted.

rob: fyi I added a watcher on the issue and will monitor CI.

maya: (reaction) :rocket:
